verdict.rationale: Typesense is open source and can be run locally or on any server, so the user decides where data lives. The docs list Docker, Kubernetes, Linux/Mac binaries, packages and a Terraform module, and explicitly offer the freedom to self-host or use a dedicated Typesense Cloud cluster. Missing for 10: documented region selection or data-residency guarantees for Typesense Cloud (the Search Delivery Network is mentioned but region choice is not), and no independent or hands-on corroboration of residency control.
